title.en: Pearl S. Buck, the setting and the people

hook.en: Your country is at war. One evening an enemy soldier, badly wounded, is washed up at your door. What would you do?

narration.en: Pearl S. Buck was an American writer who grew up in China and won the Nobel Prize for Literature. "The Enemy" is set in Japan during the Second World War, when Japan and America were enemies. The house of Dr Sadao Hoki stands on the Japanese coast, on rocks above the sea.
We map the people in Dr Sadao's world.

say.en: At the centre is Dr Sadao Hoki, the surgeon.
Hana is his wife: kind, but frightened of the danger.
The wounded American is an escaped prisoner of war.
The old General is Sadao's patient and depends on him.
Yumi, the children's nurse, refuses to wash the enemy.
The gardener and the cook disapprove and leave.
His late father taught him loyalty to Japan.

explanation.en: The story is set in Japan during the Second World War, when Japan and America were enemies.

body.en: Sadao is a gifted surgeon and scientist who studied in America for several years, where he met Hana, also Japanese and studying there. They married in Japan and have children. Their servants are the old gardener, the cook and Yumi, the children's nurse. Sadao is kept at home instead of being sent abroad with the troops because an old General may need an operation that only he can do.

points.en: Hana: his wife, met in America
Kept home to treat the old General

Their servants are the old gardener, the cook and Yumi, the children's nurse. Sadao is kept at home instead of being sent abroad with the troops because an old General may need an operation that only he can do.

problem.en: Why was Dr Sadao not sent abroad with the troops?

steps.en: The old General might need an operation.
Only Sadao was trusted to perform it.

answer.en: Sadao was kept in Japan because the old General was ill and might need an operation at any time. Sadao was the surgeon he trusted for it, so his skill made him too valuable to send abroad.

body.en: Remember the household as S-H-Y-G: Sadao the surgeon, Hana his wife, Yumi the nurse who refuses, and the General who forgets.
